risks.risk: Screen condition (cracks, burn-in, lines, dead picture tube) unknown and cannot be checked without power
risks.proof: Clear, well-lit photo or video of the screen illuminated (even via a test rig) showing picture quality

risks.risk: Brand/model/size unconfirmed, affects part availability and value
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear label/badge showing brand, model number, and screen size

risks.risk: Remote control may not actually be included or may not pair/function

risks.if_unproven: priced as TV only, no remote

proof_requests: Well-lit photo of the TV's front screen and full body
Close-up of the rear label showing brand, model, and screen size
Video of plugging in or bench-testing the unit to show the actual fault behavior
Photo of the remote control alongside the TV
Photo of all ports/connectors on the back panel
Wider, brighter shot showing the whole unit and surrounding context
response.reason: The witness confirms only a generic CRT TV/monitor with an unproven blown transformer and no visible screen, brand, or accessories, so it must be priced at worst case as a non-working, unbranded CRT pending proof photos/video.
